about_pullquote: We treat every home like it's our own, and every colour choice like it matters.
about_para_1: Wall Paper and Painting Fix has been transforming Leicester homes and businesses for nearly two decades. What began as a one-man operation has grown into a respected local practice, built on honest pricing and meticulous attention to detail. Our team combines traditional decorating craftsmanship with modern paint and wallpaper innovations, ensuring every project — whether a quick refresh or a complete redecoration — meets our exacting standards.
about_para_2: We're known in the local community for showing up on time, protecting your home during every phase of work, and delivering exactly what we promise. Repeat customers make up the bulk of our work, which tells you everything about how we operate. We listen carefully to your vision, offer frank advice on colours and materials, and never cut corners to save time.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant service. We had our whole downstairs redecorated — new paint, wallpaper in the lounge, and all the woodwork done. The lads were tidy, professional, and finished on time. Couldn't fault them. Already booked them back for the bedrooms next month.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Didn't think it was possible to get such a high-quality finish on a tight budget, but Wall Paper and Painting Fix proved me wrong. The colour advice was spot-on, and they didn't try to upsell me on unnecessary extras. Will definitely recommend to friends.
reviews.author: Helen M.

reviews.text: Had a feature wall done with textured paint and it looks stunning. The attention to detail is incredible — prep work was thorough, masking was precise, and the final finish is flawless. Great communication throughout. Top marks.
reviews.author: James R.
